chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abd Allah narrated to us, from Ahmad and Abd Allah, sons of Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, who said: I asked Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him)
about the word of Allah, the Mighty and High: (The nature made by Allah is which He has made men upon). He (AS) said: He created them all upon Divine Unity.

key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Azza wa Jalla (The Mighty and High - honorific for Allah)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Fitrah in the Quran according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Tawhid*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to establish that *Fitrah* is not merely a general inclination but specifically the innate recognition of Divine Unity (*Tawhid*). This interpretation anchors the concept of human nature within Shia theology, distinguishing the primordial state of pure monotheism from later acquired beliefs or deviations.
